caseNameFull: Demarois v. Farrel, U. S. Marshal
attorneys: Alfred Demarois, pro se. No appearance for respondents.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit, and motion for leave to proceed further in forma pauperis, denied for the reason that the Court, upon examination of the papers herein submitted, finds that the application for a writ of certiorari was not made within the time provided by law. Act of February 13, 1925, § 8 (a), 43 Stat. 936, 940.
